# EC4YOU Digital Marketing

> EC4YOU is a full-service digital marketing and technology company based in Chennai, India. We help businesses grow through innovative technology, creative design, and strategic marketing solutions.

## About

EC4YOU (ec4you.in) is a Chennai-based digital agency offering end-to-end digital solutions. Founded with the mission of making digital excellence accessible to all businesses — from startups to enterprises — we combine data-driven strategy with creative execution.

- **Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Website:** https://www.ec4you.in
- **Contact Email:** ec4youdigital@gmail.com
- **Phone:** +91 7010942474

## Services

- **Digital Marketing:** SEO, Social Media Marketing, Google Ads, Content Marketing, Email Campaigns
- **Web Development:** Custom websites, React/Next.js web apps, E-commerce, Landing pages
- **App Development:** iOS & Android mobile apps, Cross-platform development
- **Graphic Design:** Brand identity, Logo design, UI/UX design, Print & digital assets
- **Cyber Security:** Vulnerability assessment, Security audits, Data protection consulting
- **Email Marketing:** Campaign design, automation, list management, performance analytics
